summary: Preserve dry-run state and fail closed on delivery errors

delivery.outcome: Goal dry-runs are read-only, failed pushes fail closed, UV sync preserves declared verification dependencies and the CLI retains one canonical push callback
nonGoals: No public CLI, version-selection, registry credential or release-order change
No runtime dependency, GitHub policy or governance package change

architecture.decision: Keep configuration reads non-persistent in dry-run, propagate the existing push result, preserve both conventional UV verification sets, reject legacy replacement of the canonical push command and honor the optional cost-badge skip without leaking Goal-only state into project tests
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded delivery/bootstrap implementation changes and their ticket-024 regression tests

validation.evidence: Missing and existing goal.yaml remain byte-identical during dry-run
A false remote push result raises before the success summary
UV test-only extras and bootstrap dependency-set requests are preserved
Full suite, governance and container build pass
